purpose: Establish a dedicated validation hierarchy for Procedural Economics above global framework validation.

rationale.statement: Passing global_validate.py demonstrates framework consistency but does not establish economic legitimacy.
rationale.implication: Economics_app requires domain-specific validation gates before metrics, policy, or governance claims become admissible.

validation_hierarchy.relationship: Economics validation may only execute after successful global validation.

E0.name: Registry Integrity
E0.purpose: Verify economics registries, references, dependencies, and governance metadata.

E1.name: Projection Legality
E1.purpose: Verify all economics_app concepts trace to MPF primitives.
E1.success_condition: Every economics concept resolves through Sigma_D, Org_a, and D(A|B)>epsilon_a.

E2.name: Organizational Construction
E2.purpose: Verify Org_a can generate multiple Sigma_D structures from identical mismatch inventory.
E2.success_condition: Same inventory yields distinguishable Sigma_D organizations.

E3.name: Sigma_D Distinguishability
E3.purpose: Verify Sigma_D structures remain distinguishable solely through organizational differences.

E4.name: Deformation Stability
E4.purpose: Determine whether Sigma_D survives admissible deformation.

E5.name: Recovery Validity
E5.success_condition: Recoverable Sigma_D can be demonstrated after admissible loss.

E6.name: Wealth Metric Legality
E6.purpose: Validate DWI, ADW, RDW, DR, DL, DE, and DC metrics.

E7.name: Policy Admissibility
E7.purpose: Authorize governance and policy claims derived from economics_app.

immediate_action.objective: Demonstrate distinguishability of Sigma_D structures using organization alone.
immediate_action.reason: E3 is the final proof that organization carries independent information before continuity and recovery are constructed.

governance_rule.statement: No Distinction Wealth Index, economic metric, simulation result, or policy recommendation may exceed the highest validated gate status.

strong_statement: Global validation proves framework consistency. Economic validation proves economic legitimacy.
